title: Towards Secure Cloud-Native Computing: Unveiling Kubernetes Misconfigurations with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.20834v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of cloud-native computing, Organizations are increasingly adopting infrastructure models that emphasize scalability, flexibility, and efficiency. Kubernetes has become the de facto standard for orchestrating containerized applications in these environments. However, the inherent complexity of cloud-native ecosystems introduces significant challenges, particularly in the form of misconfigurations that can compromise both security and performance. This study explores the potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) in identifying Kubernetes misconfigurations. We introduce a comprehensive taxonomy of common misconfiguration types, offering a structured framework to better understand and categorize these issues. translated_title: 迈向安全的云原生计算：利用大型语言模型揭示Kubernetes错误配置
translated_abstract: 在快速发展的云原生计算领域，各组织正日益采用强调可扩展性、灵活性和效率的基础设施模型。Kubernetes已成为在这些环境中编排容器化应用的事实标准。然而，云原生生态系统固有的复杂性带来了重大挑战，尤其表现为可能危及安全性和性能的错误配置。本研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）在识别Kubernetes错误配置方面的潜力。我们提出了一个关于常见错误配置类型的全面分类体系，提供了一个结构化框架，以更好地理解和归类这些问题。此外，我们对最先进的检测工具进行了实证评估，以基准测试其有效性。此外，我们还分析了最容易发生错误配置的Kubernetes对象，并……
tldr: 本研究提出了Kubernetes常见错误配置类型的全面分类体系，对现有最先进的检测工具进行了实证评估，并探索了利用大型语言模型识别Kubernetes错误配置的潜力。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a comprehensive taxonomy of common Kubernetes misconfiguration types, empirically benchmarks state-of-the-art detection tools, and explores the potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) in identifying Kubernetes misconfigurations.
